faq_mac_q: Will it work on my Mac?
faq_mac_a: hush needs an Apple silicon Mac (M1 or newer) running macOS 15 or later. An 8 GB Mac can run transcription. We recommend 16 GB for the optional AI assistant, with room for your other apps.
faq_offline_a: Once the models are downloaded, transcription, writing styles and local AI run on your Mac. Web searches, browsing, model downloads, updates and publishing optional Verified Messages need an internet connection.
faq_assistant_a: The assistant is in beta. It can use the current screen as context, help write or revise text, and perform supported actions in your apps. Hold Control + Fn to talk, follow up by voice, and press Escape to stop and start a fresh conversation. Complex tasks may still need your help.
faq_free_a: Yes. hush is free and open source, with no account required. The Mac app is Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple. You can read the source, contribute, or make it your own.
